status: Gate A locked v2.1; complete held-state convergence audit; no controller/performance search
initial_integrator: Solve electrical/DC equilibrium; current PI z=R_f*i in dq, PLL integral=0 at 60 Hz
modulation_contract: Compute and radially limit u_dq at sample; convert to stationary alpha-beta with sampled PLL angle; normalize by sampled Vdc; delay one sample; hold normalized alpha-beta vector; u_ab(t)=Vdc(t)*m_ab_held
source_contract: At each control sample set P_b_ff to measured applied converter-terminal P_inv plus inverter losses, mapped through eta_dc_dc with correct bidirectional sign; add K_W*(Wref-Wdc) at battery-power command; hold command over sample; source lag/ramp acts continuously. No source PI. Initial command equals solved nominal P_b.
numerical_contract: Independently integrate dq and abc over identical sample intervals; exact disturbance boundaries; no state projection; detect constraint events on internal trajectory; initial maximum step 10 us, refine to 5 us.
provenance: 0.5 power/energy ratio and 690 V/1500 V class are hardware-inspired; all reduced module ratings, loops, filter, loss, DC capacitance, limits, and protection assumptions are synthetic. Capacitance H=18ms matches the dimensionless energy of public motulator 10kVA/600V/1mF example, not a scaled OEM bill of materials.
current_controller_contract: u_unsat=v_PCC + j*omega_PLL*L_f*i + Kp_i*(i_ref-i) + z_i; z_i += Ts*(Ki_i*(i_ref-i)+Kaw_i*(u_sat-u_unsat)); no separate Rf feedforward; z_i initialized Rf*i. Full-vector radial voltage saturation.
pll_controller_contract: At sample use prior applied-command PCC; normalized e=vq/max(V,Vfloor); omega=clip(omega0+Kp*e+z); z += Ts*(Ki*e+Kaw*(omega-omega_u)); theta advances by previous held omega in each sample; low V freezes z, keeps last bounded omega.
duty_controller_contract: m_ab=u_sat*exp(j*theta_PLL)/Vdc_sample, limited |m|<=k_m/sqrt(3); no prediction/phase advance; one sample transport queue. Every ODE RHS uses u_ab=Vdc(t)*m_applied. At a sample, measure old applied-command PCC, compute new m, then release preceding queued m for next interval. Initial applied and queued vectors both equal the solved continuous-equilibrium voltage at t=0 divided by Vdc; sampled dynamics are allowed to settle and are not called an exact discrete equilibrium.
state_projection: None. Constraint crossings are recorded; emergency stop at 1.10 pu actual current, DC v outside [0.8,1.1], SoC outside [.2,.8]; continuous current screen is strict 1.00 pu, no permitted overload.

case_registry.purpose: loss-bearing steady equilibrium/sample settling and energy conservation
reference-clipped PI can violate actual current; fault starts halfway between control samples

prerun_convergence.normalization: i_d,i_q in nominal source frame theta=omega0*t by Ipeak; Wdc by Wdc0; Pb by1MW; PLL phase minus omega0*t in rad; PLL integrator by omega0; current PI d/q in PLL coordinates by Vpeak; applied/queued complex stationary modulation rotated by exp(-j*omega0*t); held omega_PLL by omega0 and held P_b_command by1MW. Compare all sample vectors at t_k immediately before next update, using right-closed (t−50ms,t] against (t−100ms,t−50ms]. Batteryenergy excluded from convergence because fixed positive P discharges, but saved and bounded.
prerun_convergence.checkpoint_rule: First controller-clock boundary at 50ms checks satisfying3 consecutive convergence tests and hard-safe actual current/S/DC/Pb/SoC across prior150ms. Preserve all plant and controller states, absolute time and queued/applied modulation. No arbitrary later checkpoint.
prerun_convergence.stopping_condition: If no such checkpoint by5s, do not run the fault as settled; report failure. If counterexample disappears after settling, report it rather than alter thresholds.
